items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I know Peter Bocas. INTERVIEWEE: I know who it is and I can't say anything.

ctx.x: What about the Supreme Band? When was it going?

Oh, that was going before World War I. I came here right after World War I and I joined them. I came here, you see. I just came from school and they didn't have no violin player. At that time they had the old Imperial Band in New Orleans. Mania Parade, I think. Yeah, Mania Parade. Well, not Peter. What's this your fellow?
